description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Dreamstone Hedron and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Dreamstone Hedron and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Dreamstone Hedron and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.
